content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great day. I have reviewed the agreement and would like to propose a few minor adjustments before signing. - Regarding the scope of work, the agreement currently allows for requesting additional unspecified tasks without a corresponding change in compensation. I propose that any changes or additional services requested by the client should be agreed upon in a written change order specifying the adjusted scope and fees. - Regarding the intellectual property clause, rights are assigned immediately upon creation rather than upon receipt of full payment. I propose that upon receipt of full payment for the applicable services, the contractor hereby assigns to the client all right, title, and interest in and to the deliverables created under the agreement. Thank you for your time and cooperation, and I look forward to moving ahead.
